finding: 7,531 rows carry a negative predicted_value for metrics that cannot be negative.
evidence: 5,167 of them (69%) are REUSED_HDD_EXISTING_ARTIFACT rows, so they are a pre-existing property of the legacy v6_17 artifact, not something P5 introduced. The remaining 2,364 are GENERATED_P5. Concentrated in ARIMA_Fixed, ETS_Current, AutoARIMA, ETS Explicit, Theta, LightGBM and XGBoost. The FixedGrowth baselines contribute only tiny negatives near -1e-3.
impact_on_p6: Squared-error metrics will absorb them, but percentage-error metrics can behave oddly against a negative prediction.
recommendation: Do NOT clip retroactively: that would alter model output after the fact. Report negative prediction counts alongside accuracy in P6 so the reader can judge.

evidence: 1,146 of 1,371 (84%) are reused HDD rows. Concentrated in the neural family (NLIN-DLIN_FIXED, FNAR-V2, SMLP-TCN) and LinearRegression.
impact_on_p6: Could dominate a mean-percentage-error ranking if left unweighted.
recommendation: P6 should report median as well as mean error, so a handful of extreme ratios cannot drive the champion selection.

finding: cohort_manifest.has_15_model_backtests still reads FALSE for the 90 non-HDD series, although the artifact now contains their backtests.
evidence: P4 wrote the manifest and P5 was forbidden from modifying it.
impact_on_p6: The P7 completeness gate would under-report what actually exists and could keep 90 valid series out of the Viewer.
recommendation: P6 or P7 must refresh the flag from the artifact rather than trusting the frozen value.
